name: og-vscode
description: Edit OpenGate artifacts against a live platform. Unofficial community project, not an Amplía product.

commands.title: og: Diff this file against the platform
og: What deploying this artifact would change

og.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `og` binary. Found on `PATH` by default.

og.org.description: Organization, only if it should differ from og's own default.

og.validateOnSave.description: Validate the artifact after saving. Local, no credentials.

og.deployOnSave.markdownDescription: Deploy after saving. Off by default: writes to a live platform. `og watch` is the supported way to do this from a terminal.

og.timeout.description: Milliseconds before a CLI call is abandoned.
